title: Alarm sound not played, only vibration
symptom: Alarms only work properly for a short time after starting xDrip+, then no sound is played anymore, notification and vibration work as expected. When clicking 'Test Alert' in settings, the xDrip default sound is not played at all, system sounds are only played when 'Override phone silent mode' is not selected. The phone is not set to silent. The logs contain no error messages.
cause: The issue was initially resolved by a commit on Feb 23rd, but later reappeared, suggesting an object lifecycle or memory pressure issue, though the exact root cause was not definitively identified.
fix: The Feb 23rd nightly (commit e03c1db5abf8e7441fdb8173e1efd10f3c6bbeff) appeared to solve the problem, but it later returned. Restarting the app temporarily restored functionality.
evidence_quote: The changes in the 23rd Feb nightly ( https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/e03c1db5abf8e7441fdb8173e1efd10f3c6bbeff ) appear to have solved the problem.
